semiconductor_relevance: High — The company is a leader in TGV 3D packaging technology, which is critical for advanced semiconductor integration.
summary: 3D CHIPS (GUANGDONG) TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD. specializes in TGV (Through Glass Via) technology for 3D packaging solutions. They focus on developing and manufacturing glass-based 3D packaging substrates and microstructure glass, positioning themselves as leaders in post-Moore's Law integrated circuits.

regional_presence.China: The company has established a production base in Songshan Lake, Dongguan and a glass wafer 3D packaging pilot service platform in Minghu Science and Technology Park, Chengdu.
